No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 110000 K from De Marco et al. (2022), arXiv:2301.02775, Results: a model of the nebula's light with a central star of effective temperature 110 kK and luminosity 200 Lsun matches the observations (https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.02775). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
